scientific_detail: Calcium and Magnesium both utilize the DMT1 carrier protein in the brush border membrane of the small intestine. At standard supplemental doses, calcium exhibits an ~80% higher affinity constant, effectively displacing magnesium and causing up to 82% of ingested magnesium to be excreted unabsorbed while provoking osmotic gastrointestinal distress.
resolution_protocol: Separate intake by at least 4 hours. Take Calcium at midday with food; take Magnesium 45 minutes before sleep.

scientific_detail: Chronic ingestion of zinc (>30mg/day) induces high concentrations of mucosal metallothionein, an intracellular metal-binding protein. Metallothionein binds copper with greater avidity than zinc and traps copper within enterocytes, which are subsequently sloughed off in stool. This induces severe secondary copper deficiency, hematologic microcytic anemia, and neutropenia.
organ_impact: Bone marrow suppression, neutropenia, microcytic anemia
resolution_protocol: Maintain a strict 10:1 or 15:1 Zinc-to-Copper ratio. If taking high-dose Zinc, co-administer 2mg Copper Sebacate or Bisglycinate separated by 6 hours.

mechanism: Non-competitive allosteric inhibition of mucosal iron uptake
scientific_detail: Calcium inhibits both heme and non-heme iron absorption in a dose-dependent manner by binding to apical transferrin receptors and preventing ferroportin export into portal circulation.
organ_impact: Ferritin depletion, treatment-resistant iron deficiency anemia
resolution_protocol: Take iron completely fasted on waking with 500mg Vitamin C (ascorbic acid lowers gastric pH and maintains iron in the soluble Fe2+ ferrous state). Take Calcium at least 3 hours later.

mechanism: Hepatic withanolide glucuronidation overload and 5'-deiodinase upregulation
scientific_detail: Chronic withanolide accumulation has been clinically documented to induce drug-induced liver injury (DILI) with acute hepatocellular/cholestatic pattern, alongside excessive conversion of T4 to T3 inducing subclinical hyperthyroidism and emotional anhedonia.
organ_impact: Elevated liver transaminases (ALT/AST), emotional blunting / anhedonia
resolution_protocol: Implement strict cycling: 6 weeks ON, 2 weeks OFF. Transition to L-Theanine (200mg) during washout intervals.

scientific_detail: 5-HTP bypasses tryptophan hydroxylase rate-limiting synthesis and directly converts into serotonin, while SSRIs block presynaptic SERT reuptake. Concomitant use can provoke acute life-threatening Serotonin Syndrome.
organ_impact: Hyperthermia, neuromuscular hyperreflexia, autonomic instability, seizures
resolution_protocol: ABSOLUTELY CONTRAINDICATED. Discontinue all 5-HTP or St. John's Wort if taking serotonergic psychiatric medication.

mechanism: Dual Complex I mitochondrial respiratory chain inhibition
scientific_detail: Both Metformin and Berberine activate AMPK via mild inhibition of mitochondrial Complex I. Combining high doses causes additive hepatic gluconeogenesis suppression, risking acute hypoglycemic episodes and dangerous anaerobic lactate accumulation.
organ_impact: Lactic acidosis, hypoglycemia, acute nausea and diarrhea
resolution_protocol: Do not stack full-dose Berberine with Metformin. If combined for longevity, titrate under glycemic monitoring and split doses.

scientific_detail: Vitamin D3 and K2 are highly lipophilic seco-steroids requiring pancreatic lipase and bile salt incorporation into mixed micelles for lymphatic enterocyte transport. Fasted consumption reduces bioavailability by over 60%.
organ_impact: Arterial calcification risk if D3 taken without K2, zero therapeutic 25(OH)D increase
resolution_protocol: Must consume with a meal containing at least 12-15g of dietary fat (e.g. whole eggs, avocado, extra virgin olive oil, or Omega-3 softgels).

compound_b: Prescription Drugs metabolized by CYP3A4 / P-glycoprotein
mechanism: Intestinal and hepatic phase I clearance blockade
scientific_detail: Piperine increases curcumin bioavailability by 2000% precisely because it is a potent inhibitor of hepatic CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and P-glycoprotein efflux pumps. This causes toxic plasma accumulation of statins, beta-blockers, and anti-arrhythmics.
resolution_protocol: Take Curcumin in phytosome form (Meriva / Longvida) without piperine if taking pharmaceutical maintenance medications.

scientific_detail: Furanocoumarins in grapefruit irreversibly inactivate enterocyte CYP3A4 enzymes, increasing systemic circulating statin concentrations up to 12-fold and triggering severe rhabdomyolysis.
organ_impact: Acute rhabdomyolysis, myopathy, acute kidney injury
resolution_protocol: Eliminate grapefruit seed extract entirely when taking statins or calcium channel blockers.

mechanism: Gastric hypomotility and prolonged acid exposure
scientific_detail: GLP-1 receptor activation profoundly decelerates gastric emptying rate. Extended-release capsules and oral peptides (such as oral BPC-157 or NMN) remain trapped in the acidic stomach environment (pH 1.5-2.0) for hours, leading to acid hydrolysis and erratic pharmacokinetics.
resolution_protocol: Prefer sublingual or subcutaneous administration for longevity peptides. Take oral supplements with plenty of water at least 1 hour after waking.
